project.title: Biomass of anaerobic batch reactors subjected to different concentrations of caffeine. Metagenome
project.description: Caffeine (CAF) is one of the most consumed alkaloids in the world with numerous applications in the pharmaceutical and food industries. As a consequence, CAF has been frequently detected in several environmental matrices, since it is a compound that is difficult to remove in sewage treatment plants (STPs), in addition to presenting deleterious effects to the environment. In this study, the effects of different CAF concentration were investigated in anaerobic batch reactors using sanitary sewage from the sewage treatment plant (STP) of Sao Carlos/SP.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from Biomass of anaerobic batch reactors subjected to different concentrations of caffeine.
runs: Caffeine removal from sewage in anaerobic batch reactors with emphasis on methanogenic potential and characterization of the microbial community
